title: GYROS Instrument Preparation and Software Setup
author: Anish Chhetri
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wfnfbme

steps.title: Open Gyros Software Mini Me
steps.instruction: Launch the Gyros Software Mini Me (Bioanalytical, GYROS, EQ1960).

steps.title: Prime instrument to 200%
steps.instruction: Prime the instrument using 200% of the recommended volume.

steps.title: Download sequence file
steps.instruction: Download the required sequence file to the instrument computer.

steps.title: Prepare MRD of samples
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:2 MRD (mass ratio dilution) of the samples.

steps.title: Set capture preparation
steps.instruction: Configure capture preparation to 10 Mass per % volume.

steps.title: Prepare detector
steps.instruction: Perform detector preparation as described in the standard protocol.
